Ping an IP Address

Use this to send a "ping" packet request to the specified IPv4/IPv6 address. This is often used to test a connection. If the request "times out" (no reply is received), this usually means the destination is unreachable. However, some network devices can be configured not to respond to a ping.

Perform a DNS Lookup

A DNS (Domain Name Server) converts the Internet Name, e.g. www.sky.com, to an IP Address. If you need the IP Address of a Web, FTP, Mail or other Server on the Internet, you can do a DNS Look Up to find the IP Address.

Display the Routing Table

This operation will display the internal routing table. This information may be used by Sky Technical Support.

Reboot the Sky Hub

Use this button to perform a reboot (restart) of the Sky Hub from the device you are accessing these pages on, rather than physically rebooting the Sky Hub by turning the power off at the mains. You can reboot the Sky Hub if it seems to have become unstable or isn't operating normally.
